facts.fact: ESCOM's optic fibre business states its national fibre backbone network is 7000 km, built on its electricity poles, with transport and MPLS backbone running in two rings centred on Lilongwe and Blantyre and linking Mzuzu, Kasungu, Salima, Zomba and Mangochi.
ESCOM states its national fibre backbone covers all districts of Malawi including Likoma Island (coverage extended through investment in 2017 and 2021).

systems.platform: DWDM and MPLS, OSN equipment, fibre on electricity poles

note: Document says ESCOM sold infrastructure-as-a-service to MNOs and ISPs until 2024; no current access terms stated, so no access fact.
